warnings.headline: Yellow Near gale 14-17 m/s Southern Baltic
warnings.description:
Northeast 14-17 m/s. Sunday morning decreasing.; What should I think about?: Pay close attention to the marine forecast and prepare crew and vessel for high winds and seas.
Keep in mind that the wind gusts are often significantly higher than the average wind.; Where?: Southern Baltic
warnings.sender: SMHI, Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute

warnings.headline: Orange Gale warning for Poland - Central coastal zone
warnings.description: Wind northeast force 5 to 7, but to 8 in gusts.
warnings.instruction: TAKE PRECAUTIONS. Storm winds and increased wave can cause considerable damage to coastal areas, such as dunes, dikes, piers. Difficult navigation conditions are predicted. It is recommended to avoid traveling through coastal zone areas. In addition, when the wind direction is northern, there is flood hazard.
warnings.sender: IMGW-PIB, Marine Meteorological Forecast Office in Gdynia
